[Project]
instrument_str = OCAM

[Data]
mefpp_paf = omegacam.paf
file_format = MEF     # MEF or SINGLE, but only MEF implemented for v1.0
raw_file_prefix = OMEGA.
raw_file_suffix = .fits
reduced_file_prefix = OMEGACAM_
reduced_file_suffix = .fits

correct_light_concentration = True

# image section to check final swarp mosaic data
img_sec_x1 = 10000
img_sec_x2 = 10100
img_sec_y1 = 10000
img_sec_y2 = 10100

[Primary Keywords]
inst_name_key = INSTRUME
inst_name_val = OMEGACAM

# ------------------------ keywords to partition data ---------------------------
dateobs_key = "DATE-OBS"  # Used to group according to distance in time
                          # and to get Moon info. Uses format:
                          #    yyyy = int(self.dateobs[0:4])
                          #      mm = int(self.dateobs[5:7])
                          #      dd = int(self.dateobs[8:10])
                          #
tplnexp_key = "HIERARCH ESO TPL NEXP"   # Number of exposures in observing template
tplexpno_key = "HIERARCH ESO TPL EXPNO" # Sequential ecposure number in template
object_key = OBJECT       # Used to name partition directories and part of final image name
obstart_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS START"  # Time at which the OB was started
obid_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS ID"        # OB id of observation
inst_exp_key = EXPTIME                  # exposure time of frame. Used to convert to e/s
filt_key = "HIERARCH ESO INS FILT1 NAME"    # keyword giving the filter name
ra_key = "RA"                               # RA of telescope pointing
dec_key = "DEC"                                 # DEC of telescope pointing
targ_alpha_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL TARG ALPHA"  # Target RA. Constant in a dither sequence.
targ_delta_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL TARG DELTA"  # Target Dec. Constant in a dither sequence.
targ_name_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS TARG NAME"    # Name of target.

# ---------------------- keywords for photometryc calibration -------------------
airm_start_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL AIRM START"
airm_end_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL AIRM END"

# ---------------------- keywords for detector mode identification -----------------
#
det_mode_name = '1x1'       # if present will be used to construct suffix for product name
det_readmode_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET READ MODE"     # suffix = {readmode}_{bix}x{biny}
det_binx_key =  "HIERARCH ESO DET WIN1 BINX"
det_biny_key =  "HIERARCH ESO DET WIN1 BINY"

# ---------------- keywords that identify the different raw data types -------------
#                  and their values.
#
#                  Note that dpr.catg and dpr.type defines a product
#
#                  but if there is a list within, then you "or" that list, as with the "dpr.type == SCIENCE or dpr.type == SKY"
#                  that defines an exposure that will be reduced as a science exposure.
#

dpr_catg_key = "HIERARCH ESO DPR CATG"
dpr_type_key = "HIERARCH ESO DPR TYPE"

bias_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
bias_dpr_type_val = "BIAS"

domeff_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
domeff_dpr_type_val = "FLAT,DOME"

skyff_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
skyff_dpr_type_val = "FLAT,SKY"

std_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
std_dpr_type_val = "STD,ZEROPOINT"

sci_dpr_catg_val = "SCIENCE"
sci_dpr_type_val = "OBJECT","SKY"           # this can be a list identifying several frame types

# ---------------------- Extension header identificatio and cvharacterization keywords -----------------

[Extension Keywords]
nextensions = 32

ext_01_name = "ESO_CCD_#96"
ext_01_use = True
ext_01_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT1 CONAD"     # multiply ADU by this number to get electrons

[Project]
instrument_str = WFI

[Data]
mefpp_paf = wfi.paf
file_format = MEF     # MEF or SINGLE, but only MEF implemented for v1.0
raw_file_prefix = WFI.
raw_file_suffix = .fits
reduced_file_prefix = WFI_
reduced_file_suffix = .fits

correct_light_concentration = False

# image section to check final swarp mosaic data
img_sec_x1 = 4000
img_sec_x2 = 4100
img_sec_y1 = 4000
img_sec_y2 = 4100

[Primary Keywords]
inst_name_key = INSTRUME
inst_name_val = WFI

# ------------------------ keywords to partition data ---------------------------
dateobs_key = "DATE-OBS"  # Used to group according to distance in time
                          # and to get Moon info. Uses format:
                          #    yyyy = int(self.dateobs[0:4])
                          #      mm = int(self.dateobs[5:7])
                          #      dd = int(self.dateobs[8:10])
                          #
tplnexp_key = "HIERARCH ESO TPL NEXP"   # Number of exposures in observing template
tplexpno_key = "HIERARCH ESO TPL EXPNO" # Sequential ecposure number in template
object_key = OBJECT       # Used to name partition directories and part of final image name
obstart_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS START"  # Time at which the OB was started
obid_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS ID"        # OB id of observation
inst_exp_key = EXPTIME                  # exposure time of frame. Used to convert to e/s
filt_key = "HIERARCH ESO INS FILT1 NAME"    # keyword giving the filter name
ra_key = "RA"                               # RA of telescope pointing
dec_key = "DEC"                                 # DEC of telescope pointing
targ_alpha_key = "RA"  # No TEL TARG keywords in WFI
targ_delta_key = "DEC"  # TNo TEL TARG keywords in WFI
targ_name_key = "HIERARCH ESO OBS TARG NAME"    # Name of target.

# ---------------------- keywords for photometryc calibration -------------------
airm_start_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL AIRM START"
airm_end_key = "HIERARCH ESO TEL AIRM END"

# ---------------------- keywords for detector mode identification -----------------
#
det_mode_name = '1x1'       # if present will be used to construct suffix for product name
det_readmode_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET READ MODE"     # suffix = {readmode}_{bix}x{biny}
det_binx_key =  "HIERARCH ESO DET WIN1 BINX"
det_biny_key =  "HIERARCH ESO DET WIN1 BINY"

# ---------------- keywords that identify the different raw data types -------------
#                  and their values.
#
#                  Note that dpr.catg and dpr.type defines a product
#
#                  but if there is a list within, then you "or" that list, as with the "dpr.type == SCIENCE or dpr.type == SKY"
#                  that defines an exposure that will be reduced as a science exposure.
#

dpr_catg_key = "HIERARCH ESO DPR CATG"
dpr_type_key = "HIERARCH ESO DPR TYPE"

bias_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
bias_dpr_type_val = "BIAS"

domeff_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
domeff_dpr_type_val = "FLAT,SCREEN"

skyff_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
skyff_dpr_type_val = "FLAT,SKY"

std_dpr_catg_val = "CALIB"
std_dpr_type_val = "STD"

sci_dpr_catg_val = "SCIENCE"
sci_dpr_type_val = "OBJECT","SKY"           # this can be a list identifying several frame types

# ---------------------- Extension header identificatio and cvharacterization keywords -----------------

[Extension Keywords]        # Only CHIP1 and CHIP2 with valid data. Keyword names depend on extension!
nextensions = 8

ext_01_name = "WIN1.CHIP1.OUT1"
ext_01_use = True
ext_01_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT1 CONAD"     # multiply ADU by this number to get electrons

ext_02_name = "WIN1.CHIP2.OUT1"
ext_02_use = True
ext_02_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT2 CONAD"

ext_03_name = "WIN1.CHIP3.OUT1"
ext_03_use = True
ext_03_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT3 CONAD"

ext_04_name = "WIN1.CHIP4.OUT1"
ext_04_use = True
ext_04_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT4 CONAD"

ext_05_name = "WIN1.CHIP8.OUT1"
ext_05_use = True
ext_05_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT8 CONAD"

ext_06_name = "WIN1.CHIP7.OUT1"
ext_06_use = True
ext_06_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT7 CONAD"

ext_07_name = "WIN1.CHIP6.OUT1"
ext_07_use = True
ext_07_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT6 CONAD"

ext_08_name = "WIN1.CHIP5.OUT2"
ext_08_use = True
ext_08_gain_key = "HIERARCH ESO DET OUT5 CONAD"

[General]
debug = True
log_level = info

[Provenance]
institution = ESO
observatory = Paranal
telescope = VST
instrument = OmegaCam
